column1: # Heart (Chalice), the Kolima secret boss. Also names rows 101 and 104.

column3:
Matthew...
No. It can't be.
Not that face again.{page_break}I followed that face
through nightmares.
Now it's standing here.{end_wait}

My name is Isaac.
I don't know Matthew.
You've mistaken me.{page_break}Whatever he did,
I wasn't there.
Please, listen to me.{end_wait}

Matthew... You did this.
You ruined my face.
Don't deny it!{page_break}I remember the pain.
I remember your eyes.
You won't lie to me.{end_wait}

I paid for that defeat.
Every scar is a debt.
And you will pay.{page_break}I hid my face from
the world because of you.
Look at me now!{end_wait}

I won't lose again.
Not to you, Matthew.
Not this time.{page_break}I learned to live
with what you made me.
Can you say the same?{end_wait}

I'm not your enemy.
But I won't let you
hurt anyone else.{page_break}I can't undo the past.
I can stop you from
hurting people now.{end_wait}

No... Not again...
After everything...
After what I became...{page_break}Why do you always
get to walk away
while I stay broken?{end_wait}

It's over.
You can't keep fighting.
I'm not Matthew.{page_break}You don't have to
forgive him. But I'm
not the one you fought.{end_wait}

Liar! I'd know those eyes
anywhere, Matthew!{page_break}You scarred my face.
I see what you did
every time I wake.{end_wait}

You don't get to decide.
I won't forgive that face.
Not while I live.{page_break}Run if you want.
I'll find you again,
Matthew. I swear it.{end_wait}
